title: Handoff Lighthouse Modal and Escalation Snapshot (SLO-aware)
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and prototype a lightweight ‘Lighthouse’ handoff modal that surfaces actionable escalation context for on-call engineers. Aim: reduce time-to-triage by combining an incident summary, SLO delta snapshot, recent alert runbook links, and one-click postmortem bookmarking into a single transient surface that can be invoked from alert cards and the incident timeline.
background: Current handoff flows require toggling between the alert card, runbook, and postmortem list; new hires and cross-team responders report friction. We want an ephemeral modal that prioritizes critical triage signals (SLO breach magnitude, affected routes/models, last successful deploy) and makes it extremely easy to attach a quick note and pin a postmortem link for later retros.
acceptance_criteria: Lighthouse modal prototype with desktop + compact (mobile) breakpoints reviewed in design critique
Modal surfaces SLO delta with clear visual severity bands (green/amber/red) and numerical delta
Primary CTA: ‘Escalate + Create Handoff Note’ and secondary CTAs: ‘Open Runbook’, ‘Bookmark Postmortem’
Microcopy validated: caller identity, time-of-call, and suggested next steps
Engineering sign-off on feasible data payload for modal (<= 6 fields) and render latency expectation
Accessibility review completed (keyboard focus, color contrast)
decisions: Show SLO delta as absolute % and relative trend sparkline; do not show raw historical data in modal to avoid noise
Prefer single-step escalation flow that opens the oncall rotation chooser; defer advanced routing options to the full alert drawer
Include an opt-in checkbox to auto-attach the current incident thread to the created postmortem link
Surface last successful deploy tag if available; treat missing deploy metadata as neutral (no warning)
Keep modal payload small: title, short summary, SLO_delta, affected_routes (top 3), runbook_link, deploy_tag
tradeoffs_notes: We debated embedding a compact timeline inside the modal but chose a link-out to the incident timeline to avoid increasing render complexity and data needs. This keeps the Lighthouse modal performant for low-latency invocation during active incidents.
implementation_notes: Frontend will render from an aggregated endpoint that returns the 6 agreed fields. Backend contract doc is in Confluence (link above). Plan to gate behind feature flag 'handoff_lighthouse' for a staged rollout.
